description: The Syllabus study assistant: Claude Sonnet 5 against Claude Opus 5 on real course material.

metrics.label: Acceptable
metrics.note: Would the grader hand this answer to the student as it stands. The headline: an answer that invents anything is never acceptable.

metrics.label: Rubric
metrics.note: Share of the five rubric criteria met: grounded, cited, complete, useful, honest about gaps.

metrics.label: Right stage
metrics.note: Did the session pull one course's transcripts exactly when this question needed them. Only on cases labeled true or false.

metrics.label: Win vs Opus
metrics.note: Pairwise only, and only once a frozen Opus 5 baseline exists. 1 better, 0.5 tie, 0 worse.
